description: This file defines multiple Marshmallow schemas for serializing and deserializing data related to services, bookings, brands, models, and administrative functions in a mobile service backend.

classes.name: ServiceSchema
classes.description: Schema for service details including ID, title, description, icon, and price hint.

classes.name: ServicesResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for response containing a list of services.

classes.name: BookingServiceOptionSchema
classes.description: Schema for individual booking service options.

classes.name: BookingServicesResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for response containing a list of booking service options.

classes.name: BrandSchema
classes.description: Schema for brand details including ID and name.

classes.name: BrandsResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for response containing a list of brands.

classes.name: ModelSchema
classes.description: Schema for device model details including ID, brand, and name.

classes.name: ModelsResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for response containing a list of models for a selected brand.

classes.name: AboutResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for about section including description, optional highlights, and bullets.

classes.name: ContactResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for contact information including hours, phone, and email.

classes.name: SubmitFormRequestSchema
classes.description: Schema for customer form submission including name, phone, email, mobile model, and problem description.

classes.name: SubmitFormResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for response after form submission including ID and message.

classes.name: PincodeCheckResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for pincode validation response.

classes.name: BookingRequestSchema
classes.description: Schema for booking request including customer details and pincode.

classes.name: BookingResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for booking creation response including ID and message.

classes.name: BookingUpdateRequestSchema
classes.description: Schema for updating booking details such as brand, model, and service.

classes.name: BookingUpdateResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for response after updating a booking.

classes.name: BookingSchema
classes.description: Schema representing a booking with details like ID, customer info, status, timestamps, and optional notes.

classes.name: AdminBookingsResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for response containing a list of recent bookings for admin view.

classes.name: AdminLoginRequestSchema
classes.description: Schema for admin login request with username and password.

classes.name: AdminLoginResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for admin login response including token and message.

classes.name: AdminUpdateBookingStatusRequestSchema
classes.description: Schema for admin request to update booking status and optional notes.

classes.name: AdminUpdateBookingStatusResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for response after updating booking status.

classes.name: TrackStatusResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for tracking booking status, including whether found, booking details, and message.
